dedupe_keys.name: air passenger traffic at canadian airports annual statistics canada table 23 10 0253 01

description: Statistics Canada table 23-10-0253-01, formerly CANSIM 401-0044, gives the annual number of passengers enplaned and deplaned at Canadian airports. The table page lists annual frequency, geography for Canada and the provinces and territories, and a release on 21 July 2026, and it links related products: the Coupon Passenger Origin and Destination Report survey, the aviation data visualisation hub on airport activity, a transportation statistics dashboard and a 'stats in brief' note on airport activity in 2025. The Government of Canada open data record offers the table as CSV in English and French and as SDMX. Coverage: Canadian airports reported by Statistics Canada. Format and access: interactive table, CSV and SDMX downloads without registration. Licence and cost: Open Government Licence - Canada, free. Caveats: annual totals only; the table page read did not give the list of airports or the start year, which must be read from the table itself. It gives passenger demand for capacity planning and network flow models of air transport. It is the Canadian counterpart of the BTS T-100 statistics and the UK CAA airport statistics in the catalogue.
